name: Anticipating Shadow Points
description: Helps you ship complex engineering work without missing the obvious. Before any code is written, ASP runs an automated pre-mortem to surface failure modes that engineers (and LLMs) routinely miss on first pass — RLS policy gaps, replica lag during migrations, rate-limit issues in external APIs, deprecated callsites, monitoring blind spots, untested rollback paths. It then validates the plan with an independent agent, locks execution into a step-by-step contract with acceptance tests, and runs autonomously until done. Use before any non-trivial task: schema migrations, refactors across many files, deploys with external dependencies, RLS policy changes, or architecture decisions. Multilingual docs (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Hebrew). MIT licensed.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `anticipating-shadow-points` (Use when starting any non-trivial task (feature, refactor, migration, deploy, schema change, debug, investigation, architecture decision) that needs…) and **1 command**, `asp` (ASP (Ant-Shadow-Point) — full lifecycle: research, pre-mortem, validated plan, contractual micro-TODO, /goal-driven execution, deliverables sign-off).

Installs with `claude plugin install anticipating-shadow-points@claude-community` from `ulissesflores/anticipating-shadow-points`.
